---
name: Documentation problem
about: A doc is wrong, missing, or confusing
title: "[docs] "
labels: documentation
---

## Where

File + section (e.g. `docs/VERSIONING.md`, "Deprecation policy"; or
`DOCUMENTATION.md` §4).

## What's wrong

- [ ] Wrong/inaccurate statement
- [ ] Missing information (what?)
- [ ] Broken link / stale reference
- [ ] Instructions don't match behavior
- [ ] Hard to find (searchability)

## Suggested fix

If you have one. Corrections with a small diff are welcome — see
docs/CONTRIBUTOR_LEVELS.md (Level 1 is docs).
